items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Charlie McCurtis. All them old clarinet players, they played the variations.

ctx.x: Variations come out of High Society. It was a part of the Creole culture. [Alphonse] Picou. Big Eye Louis [Nelson]. Charlie McCurtis. All them old clarinet players, they played the variations. That’s what the instrument is for.
So it started on the clarinet and continued into the saxophone.
